name: Force Motors Limited
summary: Force Motors Limited, an integrated automobile company, designs, develops, manufactures, and sells a range of automotive components, aggregates, and vehicles in India. The company provides passenger vehicles, ambulances, school buses, and delivery van; small commercial, light commercial, multi utility vehicles, special vehicles, and spare parts; special utility vehicles, such as mobile medical units, police vans, prison vans, troop carriers, and safari vehicles; and agricultural tractors.
